# Which covered call or cash-secured put pays best for the risk?

> Free covered call and cash-secured put calculator: paste option quotes and rank strikes by annualized premium yield, chance of assignment, breakeven and payoff at expiry. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
